components.css: .ds-switch { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; border:0; border-radius:var(--r-full); background:var(--accent); color:var(--on-accent); font:700 16px var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; } .ds-switch svg { width:22px; height:22px; } .ds-switch svg path { stroke:currentColor; } .ds-switch:hover { filter:brightness(1.08); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 60%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Member row
components.description: A full-row member identity target with wrapping metadata. The neutral placeholder avoids inventing a member-colour token.
components.html: MMember namePronouns
components.css: .ds-member { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:80px; padding:14px 16px; background:var(--surface); border-radius:12px; text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink); font:400 15px/1.45 var(--font-body); } .ds-avatar { display:grid; place-items:center; width:44px; height:44px; flex:none; border-radius:50%; background:var(--surface-3); color:var(--ink); font-size:20px; font-weight:700; } .ds-member-text { display:grid; gap:4px; flex:1; min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-member-text small { font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-3); } .ds-member svg { width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-member svg path { stroke:var(--ink-3); } .ds-member:hover { background:var(--surface-2); } .ds-member:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 60%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Message actions
components.description: Labelled action rows inside a bounded popover surface.
components.css: .ds-actions { display:grid; width:280px; max-width:calc(100vw - 24px); max-height:min(70dvh,560px); overflow-y:auto; padding:6px; color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-pop); } .ds-actions button { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:48px; padding:10px 12px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); text-align:left; font:400 15px var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; } .ds-actions svg { width:20px; height:20px; color:var(--ink-3); } .ds-actions svg path { stroke:currentColor; } .ds-actions button:hover { background:var(--surface-2); } .ds-actions .ds-delete, .ds-actions .ds-delete svg { color:var(--danger); } .ds-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 60%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Member identity and current presence are easy to read while the surrounding app stays quiet.
The owner's Figma guide establishes charcoal canvas, stepped panels, teal actions, warm text,
Hanken Grotesk, round member-colour avatar discs and containment-style fronting (D-079).
Dark is the default; Light and Follow device are explicit per-device choices.

This document merges the implemented UI1 visual foundation with the existing v1 design spec.
Observed foundation rules come from `design/tokens.json`, generated CSS/Kotlin, the Svelte and
Compose sources, and the web review captures. `scripts/gen-tokens.mjs` remains the executable
source-of-truth bridge; frontmatter records its palette, radii and spacing. The type roles and
component entries additionally record reused values in the shipped web source. See
[UI_REDESIGN.md](UI_REDESIGN.md) for source frames, implementation boundary and review limits.
The screen inventory and broad settings catalogue below remain specification, with completion
tracked in `PROGRESS.md`; they are not a claim that every control has been implemented.
Legacy numbered references resolve as follows: §1 → frontmatter and Colors/Typography/Shapes;
§2 → Layout; §3–§6 → Components (inventory, patterns, display styles, Basic/Advanced);
§7–§8 → Accessibility and voice under Do's and Don'ts.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral stepped surfaces support member identity and readable content.
Teal marks actions, selected destinations and current presence.
Rounded rows and containers use restrained borders and almost no elevation.
Basic stays small; additional controls remain reachable in Advanced.
Quiet, short copy describes the saved state and the next action.

rules.name: The Members Are the Colour Rule
rules.body: Keep chrome neutral; member colour belongs to identity, selection and presence rather than unrelated decoration.

dos: Do use the shared generated palette and per-device Dark / Light / Follow device setting.
Do adapt member names, rings and avatar foreground through shared core.
Do keep Basic small and expose additional controls through Advanced.
Do retain visible audience, author and presence labels before an action is sent.
Do preserve keyboard access, visible focus, OS text scaling and reduced motion.
Do use the local Figma-derived icon set and record asset provenance.
donts: Don't ship reference screenshots or review fixtures as application UI assets.
Don't use colour as the only indication of presence, selection or an error.
Don't imply that approved pending named fronts, independent layers or polls already exist.
Don't turn a legacy implementation exception into a new system-wide visual rule.
